name: release-targets
//: The release declaration (release-targets.toml) and its probe (scripts/release-probe.sh, whose path the declaration names, so it stays in scripts/). Edges: llmlint owns release-targets.toml and the manifests it reads, ci-workflows owns release.yml, repo-tooling owns the probe.

options.command: bash tools/coverage/shcov.sh run release-targets -- cargo nextest run -p llmlint-release-targets --locked

test.//: The offline half: the declaration held to the canonical schema (restated here), to release.yml and the manifests, and the probe against a local stand-in registry. Cached: its inputs are every file it reads, every workspace member's Cargo.toml among them. Its edges cannot reach the e2e, capture and bench members (the tag boundaries), so a manifest edit made only there is caught by the release-PR full sweep, before anything ships, rather than by the affected tier.

network.//: The network half, outside the gate tiers: the restated schema reconciled against onevcs's canonical one, and the probe against live crates.io and PyPI. Run by `just test-release-targets` in the Release targets workflow.
